title: MC Sprint — Routing Trace Row
description: Per-artifact provenance row written by scripts/sprint/routing.js record at every sprint-artifact finalize boundary. Append-only JSONL at paths.sprintDecisions/routing-trace.jsonl. One row per (sprint_id, phase, artifact_id) finalization. Coverage and check subcommands query these rows. See SP-20260514-002 PRD R-2.

sprint_id.description: Sprint the artifact belongs to. Must exist in paths.sprintActiveRegistry.

phase.description: Routing phase whose model_class the trace asserts was honored.

artifact_id.description: Stable id or path identifying the artifact (PC-..., T-..., RL-..., 'retro:<sprint-id>', 'design:<sprint-id>', etc.).

artifact_path.description: Optional repo-relative path to the artifact file when available. Free-text for non-file artifacts.

model.description: provider:model identifier that drafted the artifact (e.g. claude:claude-opus-4-8, openai:gpt-5.5).

model_class.description: Optional name of the routing model_class for this phase at record-time (informational; coverage re-derives from policy).

diff_reviewer.description: provider:model identifier of the second-vendor diff reviewer, or null when diff_review was not required or fell back to single_vendor_session.

evidence.description: Honesty marker. 'ok' = normal; 'single_vendor_session' = diff_review was required but no second vendor available, decision_ledger_ref MUST be set; 'mismatch_override' = operator allowed a class mismatch (rare; decision_ledger_ref MUST be set).

decision_ledger_ref.description: Pointer into paths.decisionLedger. REQUIRED when evidence is 'single_vendor_session' or 'mismatch_override'. Free-text id, line number, or short tag.

recorded_by.description: Agent or skill that recorded the trace (alpha, beta, gamma, delta, /sprint:plan, /sprint:design, …).

ticket_id.description: Optional T-NNN reference when the artifact is a ticket-scoped phase (execution, qa, redteam).

notes.description: Optional free-text. Keep short; long-form belongs in decision-ledger.
